Gather together with the citizens of Lion’s Arch to enjoy another year of tricks, treats, and terrible jokes.}} [[Halloween]] is a [[festival]] celebrated annually in October and November in the world of [[Tyria (world)|Tyria]]. Lasting three weeks, this celebration brings many seasonal events and activities in [[Lion's Arch]] and [[starting area]]s. This period is also denoted by the weakening of the barriers separating Tyria from [[the Underworld]], resulting in many paranormal phenomena, and the arrival of the [[Mad King Thorn]], his [[Lunatic Court]], candy elementals, as well as a myriad of ghosts and other creatures. == Releases == * [[Shadow of the Mad King 2012]] (2012-10-22 — 2012-11-01) * [[Blood and Madness 2013]] (2013-10-15 — 2013-11-11) * [[Blood and Madness 2014]] (2014-10-21 — 2014-11-04) * [[Shadow of the Mad King 2015]] (2015-10-23 — 2015-11-06) * [[Shadow of the Mad King 2016]] (2016-10-18 — 2016-11-08) * [[Shadow of the Mad King 2017]] (2017-10-17 — 2017-11-07) * [[Shadow of the Mad King 2018]] (2018-10-16 — 2018-11-06) * [[Shadow of the Mad King 2019]] (2019-10-15 — 2019-11-05) * [[Shadow of the Mad King 2020]] (2020-10-13 — 2020-11-03) * [[Shadow of the Mad King 2021]] (2021-10-05 — 2021-11-09) * [[Shadow of the Mad King 2022]] (2022-10-18 — 2022-11-08) * [[Shadow of the Mad King 2023]] (2023-10-17 — 2023-11-07) * [[Shadow of the Mad King 2024]] (2024-10-15 — 2024-11-05) * [[Shadow of the Mad King 2025]] (2025-10-07 — 2025-11-04) * [[Shadow of the Mad King 2026]] (2026-10-13 — 2026-11-03) == Story == {{see|Halloween/story|label=For story related to Halloween}} Since its original release, Shadow of the Mad King contains story related to the [[Mad King Thorn]], his allies and foes, which is told via [[event]]s, [[collection]]s, and historically via [[story]] instances. == Activities == === Zones === {| {{STDT|location sortable}} style="max-width:134em;" |- ! class="unsortable" | Loading screen !! [[File:Wintersday The Wondrous Workshop of Toymaker Tixx banner.jpg|500px|right]] [[Wintersday]] is an annual [[festival]] which celebrates the [[Tyria]]n New Year according to the [[Mouvelian calendar]] and [[gww:Dynastic Reckoning|Dynastic Reckoning]]. It is the celebration of the end of the Season of the Colossus and the beginning of the Season of the Zephyr. [[Celestial Dragon]]s have been added to [[Lion's Arch]] and each race's capital city: [[Black Citadel]], [[Hoelbrak]], [[Rata Sum]], and [[The Grove]] for easier access. Earn or purchase [[Lucky Envelope]]s for a chance to win [[coin]], [[luck]], or special items. [[File:Super Adventure Festival banner.jpg|400px|right]] [[Super Adventure Festival]] is a [[festival]] celebrated annually in the world of [[Tyria]], that grants players access to the [[Super Adventure Box]]. It is a special [[dungeon]], available to be either tackled on solo or with a group. While the main entrance is in [[Creator's Commons]] inside [[Rata Sum]], [[Portal to Super Adventure Box|portals]] for easier access have been added to [[Lion's Arch]], [[Eye of the North]], and each race's capital city as well: [[Black Citadel]], [[Hoelbrak]], and [[The Grove]].
